Summary of the manual’s guidance for loss of control/link (Matris 4T):

- If the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, a loss of the remote controller signal automatically triggers Failsafe RTH.
- The aircraft will start RTH and follow an RTH path generated before the signal was lost, using Advanced RTH

text: The DJI Matrice 4T incident report found in the collection does not describe a lost link, so it is not used as evidence. According to the manual, when the RC signal is lost and the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH. It will start RTH using Advanced RTH per the RTH settings and will remain in RTH even if the RC link is later restored. If lighting and environment are unsuitable for the vision system, it will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
